homeTitle: Labora — Find the professor who fits you
homeDescription: Discover researchers from the world's scholarly record, understand their work in plain language, and get AI-matched with labs that fit your skills and working style.
discoverDescription: Search researchers who are actively publishing on your interest, at any university, from an open scholarly database.
professorDescription: A researcher's publications, topics, plain-English summary and outreach tools.
positionsDescription: Research roles posted directly by verified professors — paid, for credit or volunteer.
positionDescription: Read about the role and the lab's research, then apply.
labDescription: A lab's research, culture, open positions and materials.
checkerDescription: Paste your outreach email and see which phrases sound generic, flattering or vague — without rewriting it for you.
followUpDescription: Two well-timed follow-up drafts for emails to professors that got no reply, with calendar reminders.
frameworkDescription: A fill-in-the-blank structure for emailing professors, plus the phrases to avoid.
examplesDescription: Three illustrative outreach emails with line-by-line notes on why they work.
fieldsDescription: Find researchers and outreach tips for your discipline.
blogDescription: How to find, contact and impress a research mentor.
pricingDescription: Search is free. Passes unlock the email finder, unlimited summaries and unlimited email checks.
aiMatchDescription: Match students and labs on skills, interests, availability and working style — with explanations for every result.
howDescription: Four steps from curiosity to a real conversation with a professor.
playbookDescription: Structure, timing and the follow-up ladder behind emails that get replies.
feedbackDescription: Suggest features, report bugs and vote on what we build next.
contactDescription: Questions, ideas or account help — we read every message.
